name: labs/vcjdeboer__odyssey-app-hap
title: LI-COR Odyssey Classic 9120 infrared imager (CGI over HTTP)
intro: LI-COR Odyssey Classic 9120 infrared imager (CGI over HTTP), adapted from vcjdeboer/odyssey-app-hap. It reads `state`, `progress_percent`, `time_remaining`, `current_user` and 2 more; sets `scan_name`, `scan_group`, `resolution`, `quality` and 9 more; runs `control_scan`, `safe_stop` and `capture`. `control_scan`: start, pause, stop or cancel the configured scan through command.pl. A hardware driver: the market serves its fake backend, so no instrument is needed.
